appDescription: A ride companion that tells a passenger where the car is going and how far along the trip is, as many times as needed, so the driver can keep driving.

function.name: REPEAT_TRIP_ANSWER
function.description: Tell the passenger again, by voice, where the car is going and how far along the trip is.

function.name: PAUSE_VOICE_GUIDE
function.description: Pause the voice guidance for the passenger for a while. Safety notices are still given.

minutes.description: How many minutes to stay quiet. Ten minutes when not given.

function.name: START_COMPANION_TRIP
function.description: Start the ride companion for the passenger using a saved frequent trip.

destinationName.description: Name of the saved destination to use. The most recently used trip when not given.
